recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the already-applied FHIR-30515 response parameter without reopening the related ConceptMap policy decisions already represented by FHIR-40504 and FHIR-33032.
issue_request: FHIR-30515 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that ConceptMap/$translate output expose dependsOn data in each match, with value choices aligned to the ConceptMap dependsOn/product choice-type model and the related match.product corrections from FHIR-28284.
initial_application: Commit 3a8665b9c2 added match.dependsOn and changed match.product for the original R5 ConceptMap work; later ConceptMap2-to-ConceptMap and OperationDefinition refactors converted the value choices to allowedType. The output parameter existed, but later ConceptMap model changes left match.dependsOn.value with stale allowed types while adjacent dependency.value and match.product.value were updated.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-operations.xml includes OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. FHIR-40504 split mapping properties from additional attributes and set the active additional-attribute value choices to code, Coding, string, boolean, and Quantity; FHIR-33032 later added id and is already represented on the combined branch. The current ConceptMap product backbone inherits dependsOn by contentReference, so match.dependsOn and match.product should expose the same value type set.
reconciliation: Changed source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml so match.dependsOn.value allows code, Coding, string, boolean, Quantity, and id, matching ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.value[x], ConceptMap.group.element.target.product, dependency.value, and match.product.value.
source_changes: source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml: replaced stale match.dependsOn.value allowedType entries integer/dateTime/decimal/uri with Quantity, leaving the final list code, Coding, string, boolean, Quantity, id.

Added id to ConceptMap dependsOn/product values; already represented on the combined branch and included in the reconciled allowedType list.
